title: INSANE Extended Warranty SCAM CAUGHT ON CAMERA | DO NOT FALL FOR THIS!
summary: A YouTuber records and reacts to a live extended-warranty robocall scam targeting a car he doesn't even own, unpacking the tactics used.

assertions.quote: the payments are going to begin on that warranty at this time

verdicts.note: This exact 'your warranty payments are starting' pretext is a widely documented tactic behind the mass auto-warranty robocall operations the FTC has prosecuted

assertions.quote: they never tell you how many months it's just sign up

verdicts.note: Omitting total contract length while quoting a low monthly rate is a common sales tactic, though it isn't established as a universal feature of every such scam call

assertions.quote: they probably look at the State registration data and they compare who bought a vehicle to when the manufacturer warranty falls off

verdicts.note: This is the speaker's own speculation about the callers' methods, not something independently confirmed in the clip

assertions.quote: you could cancel a vehicle service contract which is called an extended warranty and get a prorated refund
we make 600 so there's six hundred dollars in markup
the FTC is doing nothing about this

verdicts.note: The FTC and state attorneys general have actively prosecuted and fined major auto-warranty robocall operations in recent years, contradicting a 'doing nothing' framing
